title: Character Prompt Builder Prompt Dialects
description: How one family of models reads a prompt: its tag grammar, the blocks it expects and in what order, and the vocabulary that acts on it. A model record names the dialect it belongs to, and a guide rule names the dialects it applies to, so knowledge from one family never reaches another.

corpora.description: The tag corpora this family was trained on, so a term can be checked against the right one.

tag_separator.description: What sits between two tags, written out.

multi_word_tags.description: How a tag of more than one word is spelled on this family.

artist_tag_form.description: How an artist tag is written on this family.

weight_range.description: The working range for an explicit numeric weight on this family, low then high. Omit where the family's own material states none.

block_order.description: The blocks a rendition is built from, in the order this family expects them.

rating_terms.description: The content-register terms this family carries. One per rendition.

period_terms.description: The terms that bias the render toward a slice of the corpus by date. One per rendition.

inert_terms.description: Terms with no learned meaning on this family, which spend budget and act on nothing.

negative_form.description: How this family writes a source the negative-policy resource activates.
